messages:
alice (runtime): quick heads-up — nightly microharness flagged regressions on Ampere for short/mid seq kernels. perf-bot posted the summary. anyone on call?

perf-bot: nightly-run 2026-03-17 03:00 UTC: 317 tests run, 12 regressions flagged. top 3: kernel_x_smallseq (lat +18%), kernel_y_prefill (p99 +120ms), kv-prefetch miss spike. full report: https://ci.internal/runs/3174200000

ben (perf): looking now. initial flame graph shows an extra memcpy in kernel_x when seq_len<=64. suspect fallback GEMM path triggers.

caroline (mlops): i see autotune picked a u8-quant kernel on Ampere for small seq in that rollout — could be precision-guard or fallback interplay. we deployed picklist changes ~2026-03-16T22:12.

alice (runtime): confirmed rollout at 22:12. can we rollback that picklist quickly if needed?

dave (sre): rollback across the pool risks capacity churn. we can canary-rollback a subset. what's expected latency/cost hit if we revert?

ben (perf): short triage: local microbench with a small fix (avoid redundant memcpy) brings kernel_x back to baseline. opened PR: https://git/repo/pull/1234 — needs CI microbench pass.

erin (fwk): running a focused harness against the ampere pool now: `./harness --arch ampere --seq 16,32,64 --kernels kernel_x,kernel_y --runs 1000`

perf-bot: queued harness job j-9876. logs: https://ci.internal/logs/j-9876

perf-bot: job j-9876 finished: kernel_x_smallseq p50 12.8ms -> 10.9ms (after patch); kernel_y_prefill p99 220ms -> 98ms on canary hosts. 3/3 reproductions of improvement.

caroline (mlops): can we add a seq-conditioned override in autotune to prefer the fallback-less kernel when seq<=64? that would avoid hitting the problematic path.

alice (runtime): yes — short-term override works. also we need a perf CI guard: add a microbench that asserts p99 within X% for seq buckets <64 to catch regressions from future picklist changes.

ben (perf): will open follow-up to add the guard and a probe in nightly harness to sample picklist choices after rollouts.

dave (sre): if PR & override don't land by EOD i'll schedule canary rollback. i'll coordinate with infra to avoid capacity thrash.

erin (fwk): kicking off extended harness overnight across ampere/canary hosts, will post morning summary and raw csv.

alice (runtime): summary/action items: 1) merge ben's PR to remove redundant memcpy (ben). 2) add seq-conditioned picklist override (caroline). 3) add microbench p99 guard + nightly picklist probe (ben). 4) extended harness run + results (erin). thanks everyone :thumbsup:

ben (perf): noted, will do PR followups and CI job.

caroline (mlops): adding seq-rule to picklist service and unit test + integration smoke.

perf-bot: automated note: ticket PERF-6421 created and linked to run 3174200000

alice (runtime): closing loop — ping here when CI green or if any flakiness pops up.
